facts.text: Under the Garden State Guarantee at TCNJ, eligible New Jersey students with family adjusted gross incomes between $0 and $65,000 receive free tuition and mandatory fees.

sources.title: Garden State Guarantee - TCNJ | Financial Aid
sources.quote: These students may be eligible for free tuition and mandatory fees after financial aid is applied.

sources.title: Garden State Guarantee - TCNJ | Financial Aid
sources.quote: There are no proposed eligibility changes to Tier 1, which pertains to students with AGIs between $0 and $65,000.
